```{r}
generate_jrssb_dgp <- function(
  n,
  p            = 10,      # total number of covariates
  rho          = 0.5,     # AR(1) correlation in W (ignored if W is given)
  n_shared     = 3,       # W's that affect both A and Y
  n_A_only     = 3,       # W's that affect A only
  n_Y_only     = 3,       # W's that affect Y only
  beta_A_to_Y  = 1.5,     # direct treatment effect on Y when A = 1
  sparsity     = 1.0,     # probability each coefficient is kept nonzero
  scale_A      = 1.0,     # overall scaling for linpred_A
  scale_Y      = 1.0,     # overall scaling for f_W
  # coefficient distribution controls
  sd_shared_A  = 1.0,     # SD for shared coefficients in treatment model
  sd_shared_Y  = 1.0,     # SD for shared coefficients in outcome model
  corr_shared  = 0.7,     # correlation between shared A and Y effects
  sd_A_only    = 0.7,     # SD for A-only coefficients
  sd_Y_only    = 0.7,     # SD for Y-only coefficients
  sigma_Y      = 1.0,     # noise SD in outcome
  # ℓ¹-radius for coefficients
  l1_max_A     = 3.0,
  l1_max_Y     = 3.0,
  seed         = NULL,
  W            = NULL     # optional external design matrix
) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  # If W is supplied, infer n and p from it and skip covariance generation
  if (!is.null(W)) {
    W <- as.matrix(W)
    n <- nrow(W)
    p <- ncol(W)
    Sigma <- NULL  # unknown / not used in this case
  } else {
    if (n_shared + n_A_only + n_Y_only > p) {
      stop("n_shared + n_A_only + n_Y_only must be <= p.")
    }

    if (rho != 0) {
      if (!requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop("Package 'MASS' is required for mvrnorm when rho != 0.")
      }

      # 1. AR(1) covariance and covariates W
      make_ar1_cov <- function(p, rho) {
        idx <- 1:p
        outer(idx, idx, function(i, j) rho^abs(i - j))
      }

      Sigma <- make_ar1_cov(p, rho)
      mu_W  <- rep(0, p)

      W <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = n, mu = mu_W, Sigma = Sigma)
      colnames(W) <- paste0("W", 1:p)
    } else {
      # rho = 0 → independent N(0,1) coordinates; Sigma = I_p
      Sigma <- diag(p)
      W <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), nrow = n, ncol = p)
      colnames(W) <- paste0("W", 1:p)
    }
  }

  #----------------------------------------
  # 2. Indices for confounding structure
  #----------------------------------------
  if (n_shared + n_A_only + n_Y_only > p) {
    stop("n_shared + n_A_only + n_Y_only must be <= p.")
  }

  idx_shared <- seq_len(n_shared)
  idx_A_only <- if (n_A_only > 0) {
    max(idx_shared) + seq_len(n_A_only)
  } else integer(0)

  idx_Y_only <- if (n_Y_only > 0) {
    max(c(idx_shared, idx_A_only)) + seq_len(n_Y_only)
  } else integer(0)

  #----------------------------------------
  # 3. Draw coefficient vectors beta_A, beta_Y
  #    with realistic shared confounding
  #----------------------------------------
  beta_A <- rep(0, p)
  beta_Y <- rep(0, p)

  # Shared coefficients: bivariate normal with positive correlation
  if (n_shared > 0) {
    if (!requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE)) {
      stop("Package 'MASS' is required for mvrnorm (shared coefficients).")
    }

    Sigma_shared <- matrix(
      c(sd_shared_A^2, corr_shared * sd_shared_A * sd_shared_Y,
        corr_shared * sd_shared_A * sd_shared_Y, sd_shared_Y^2),
      nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE
    )
    shared_draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(
      n   = n_shared,
      mu  = c(0, 0),
      Sigma = Sigma_shared
    )
    beta_A[idx_shared] <- shared_draws[, 1]
    beta_Y[idx_shared] <- shared_draws[, 2]
  }

  # A-only coefficients
  if (length(idx_A_only) > 0) {
    beta_A[idx_A_only] <- rnorm(length(idx_A_only), mean = 0, sd = sd_A_only)
  }

  # Y-only coefficients
  if (length(idx_Y_only) > 0) {
    beta_Y[idx_Y_only] <- rnorm(length(idx_Y_only), mean = 0, sd = sd_Y_only)
  }

  # Sparsity: independently zero out coefficients with prob 1 - sparsity
  if (sparsity < 1) {
    keep_A <- rbinom(p, size = 1, prob = sparsity)
    keep_Y <- rbinom(p, size = 1, prob = sparsity)
    beta_A <- beta_A * keep_A
    beta_Y <- beta_Y * keep_Y
  }

  # Optional scaling of signal strength
  beta_A <- scale_A * beta_A
  beta_Y <- scale_Y * beta_Y

  # 3b. ℓ¹-normalization of coefficient vectors
  norm1_A <- sum(abs(beta_A))
  if (norm1_A > 0 && norm1_A > l1_max_A) {
    beta_A <- beta_A * (l1_max_A / norm1_A)
  }

  norm1_Y <- sum(abs(beta_Y))
  if (norm1_Y > 0 && norm1_Y > l1_max_Y) {
    beta_Y <- beta_Y * (l1_max_Y / norm1_Y)
  }

  #----------------------------------------
  # 3c. Confounding structure: shared vs A-only vs Y-only
  #     f_W uses shared + Y-only; A uses shared + A-only
  #----------------------------------------
  f_shared <- if (n_shared > 0) {
    as.numeric(W[, idx_shared, drop = FALSE] %*% beta_Y[idx_shared])
  } else {
    0
  }

  f_Y_only <- if (length(idx_Y_only) > 0) {
    as.numeric(W[, idx_Y_only, drop = FALSE] %*% beta_Y[idx_Y_only])
  } else {
    0
  }

  f_W <- f_shared + f_Y_only  # baseline outcome signal

  g_shared <- if (n_shared > 0) {
    as.numeric(W[, idx_shared, drop = FALSE] %*% beta_A[idx_shared])
  } else {
    0
  }

  g_A_only <- if (length(idx_A_only) > 0) {
    as.numeric(0.5*sin(2*W)[, idx_A_only, drop = FALSE] %*% beta_A[idx_A_only])
  } else {
    0
  }

  linpred_A <- g_shared + g_A_only

  #----------------------------------------
  # 4. Treatment model: A | W ~ Bernoulli(pi0(W))
  #----------------------------------------
  pi0 <- plogis(linpred_A)   # true propensity P(A = 1 | W)
  A   <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = pi0)

  #----------------------------------------
  # 5. Outcome model:
  #    Y = f(W) + beta_A_to_Y * A + eps
  #    E[Y | A = 0, W] = f_W
  #    E[Y | A = 1, W] = f_W + beta_A_to_Y
  #----------------------------------------
  mu  <- f_W + beta_A_to_Y * A           # E[Y | A, W]
  mu0 <- f_W + beta_A_to_Y              # E[Y | A = 1, W] (for convenience)

  Y <- mu + rnorm(n, sd = sigma_Y)

  list(
    n      = n,
    p      = p,
    W      = W,
    A      = A,
    Y      = Y,
    pi0    = pi0,
    mu0    = mu0,        # E[Y | A = 1, W]
    mu     = mu,         # E[Y | A, W]
    Sigma  = Sigma,
    beta_A = beta_A,
    beta_Y = beta_Y,
    beta_A_to_Y = beta_A_to_Y,
    idx_shared  = idx_shared,
    idx_A_only  = idx_A_only,
    idx_Y_only  = idx_Y_only,
    params = list(
      rho          = rho,
      n_shared     = n_shared,
      n_A_only     = n_A_only,
      n_Y_only     = n_Y_only,
      sparsity     = sparsity,
      scale_A      = scale_A,
      scale_Y      = scale_Y,
      sd_shared_A  = sd_shared_A,
      sd_shared_Y  = sd_shared_Y,
      corr_shared  = corr_shared,
      sd_A_only    = sd_A_only,
      sd_Y_only    = sd_Y_only,
      sigma_Y      = sigma_Y,
      l1_max_A     = l1_max_A,
      l1_max_Y     = l1_max_Y
    )
  )
}

```


```{r}
compute_beta_n0 <- function(
  base_mu = c("lasso", "linear", "ridge", "gam", "earth"),
  n = 2000,
  N_big = 50000,
  N_proj = NULL,        # size for projection-training samples (default = N_big)
  seed = 123,
  print_diag = TRUE,
  dgp_fun,              # e.g. generate_jrssb_dgp
  dgp_args = list()     # list of additional args for DGP
) {
  base_mu <- match.arg(base_mu)
  set.seed(seed)

  if (is.null(N_proj)) N_proj <- N_big

  library(glmnet)
  if (!requireNamespace("xgboost", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'xgboost' is required for compute_beta_n0().")
  }
  if (base_mu == "gam") {
    library(mgcv)
  }

  #========================================
  # 1. Original sample: fit mu_n using DGP
  #========================================
  d_small <- do.call(
    dgp_fun,
    c(list(n = n, seed = seed), dgp_args)
  )

  W <- d_small$W
  A <- d_small$A
  Y <- d_small$Y

  p <- ncol(W)
  colnames(W) <- if (is.null(colnames(W))) paste0("W", 1:p) else colnames(W)

  # propensity (always lasso, estimated) -- not used, but could be for diagnostics
  x_A <- as.matrix(W)
  fit_lasso_A <- cv.glmnet(x_A, A, family = "binomial", alpha = 1)

  # outcome model mu_n base learner
  dat <- data.frame(Y = Y, A = A, W)

  if (base_mu == "lasso") {
    x_Y <- as.matrix(cbind(A = A, W))
    fit_mu <- cv.glmnet(x_Y, Y, family = "gaussian", alpha = 1)
    mu_n_fun_init <- function(W_new) {
      X1_new <- as.matrix(cbind(A = 1, W_new))
      as.numeric(predict(fit_mu, newx = X1_new, s = "lambda.min"))
    }
  } else  if (base_mu == "ridge") {
    x_Y <- as.matrix(cbind(A = A, W))
    fit_mu <- cv.glmnet(x_Y, Y, family = "gaussian", alpha = 0)
    mu_n_fun_init <- function(W_new) {
      X1_new <- as.matrix(cbind(A = 1, W_new))
      as.numeric(predict(fit_mu, newx = X1_new, s = "lambda.min"))
    }
  } else if (base_mu == "linear") {
    fit_mu <- lm(Y ~ A + ., data = dat)
    mu_n_fun_init <- function(W_new) {
      df_new <- data.frame(A = 1, as.data.frame(W_new))
      colnames(df_new) <- c("A", colnames(W))
      as.numeric(predict(fit_mu, newdata = df_new))
    }
  } else if (base_mu == "gam") {
    fmla <- as.formula(
      paste(
        "Y ~ A +",
        paste(
          sprintf("s(%s)", colnames(W)),
          collapse = " + "
        )
      )
    )

    fit_mu <- gam(fmla, data = dat)
    mu_n_fun_init <- function(W_new) {
      df_new <- data.frame(A = 1, as.data.frame(W_new))
      colnames(df_new) <- c("A", colnames(W))
      as.numeric(predict(fit_mu, newdata = df_new))
    }
  } else if (base_mu == "earth") {
  if (!requireNamespace("earth", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'earth' is required for base_mu = 'earth'.")
  }

  fit_mu <- earth::earth(Y ~ A + ., data = dat)

  mu_n_fun_init <- function(W_new) {
    df_new <- data.frame(A = 1, as.data.frame(W_new))
    colnames(df_new) <- c("A", colnames(W))
    as.numeric(predict(fit_mu, newdata = df_new))
  }
}

  # isotonic calibration of mu_n on A=1
  mu_n <- mu_n_fun_init(W)
  calibrator <- as.stepfun(isoreg(mu_n[A == 1], Y[A == 1]))
  mu_n_fun <- function(W_new) calibrator(mu_n_fun_init(W_new))

  #========================================
  # 2. Large independent dataset via DGP
  #========================================
  d_big <- do.call(
    dgp_fun,
    c(list(n = N_big, seed = seed + 1L), dgp_args)
  )

  W_big   <- d_big$W
  A_big   <- d_big$A
  Y_big   <- d_big$Y
  mu0_big <- d_big$mu0   # true E[Y | A=1, W]
  pi0_big <- d_big$pi0   # true P(A=1 | W)

  colnames(W_big) <- if (is.null(colnames(W_big))) {
    paste0("W", 1:ncol(W_big))
  } else {
    colnames(W_big)
  }

  #========================================
  # 3. Evaluate nuisances on big sample
  #========================================
  
  mu_n_big      <- mu_n_fun(W_big)

  # IPW weight term (using true pi0)
  Delta_big <- A_big / pi0_big

  #========================================
  # 4. Conditional projections onto mu_0(X)
  #    Each projection uses an independent DGP draw
  #========================================
  rf_project <- function(gen_fun,
                         mu0_eval,
                         n_train,
                         seed_rf,
                         dgp_fun,
                         dgp_args,
                         num.trees = 10,
                         max.depth = 20,
                         n_subsample = 2e6,
                         min.node = 1000) {

    # Generate independent training data
    print("sample")
    d_train <- do.call(
      dgp_fun,
      c(list(n = n_train, seed = seed_rf), dgp_args)
    )
    print("done")

    mu0_train <- d_train$mu0
    z_train   <- gen_fun(d_train)  # target on training sample

    # xgboost expects a matrix
    X_train <- matrix(mu0_train, ncol = 1)
    n <- length(z_train)

    # subsample if needed
    idx_fit <- if (n > n_subsample) sample.int(n, n_subsample) else seq_len(n)
    X_fit   <- X_train[idx_fit, , drop = FALSE]
    z_fit   <- z_train[idx_fit]

    dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = X_fit, label = z_fit)

    params <- list(
      objective         = "reg:squarederror",
      booster           = "gbtree",
      max_depth         = max.depth,
      eta               = 1,            # no shrinkage → RF-like
      subsample         = 0.2,
      colsample_bytree  = 1.0,
      num_parallel_tree = num.trees,
      min_child_weight  = min.node,
      nthread           = 4
    )
    print("fit")
    fit <- xgboost::xgb.train(
      params  = params,
      data    = dtrain,
      nrounds = 1,
      verbose = 0
    )
    print("d")
    X_eval <- matrix(mu0_eval, ncol = 1)
    dtest  <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = X_eval)
    as.numeric(predict(fit, dtest))
  }

  dgp_args[["W"]] <- W_big
  # Projections:
  # Π Δ : z(W, A, π0) = A / π0
  Pi_Delta_big <- rf_project(
    gen_fun  = function(d) d$A / d$pi0,
    mu0_eval = mu0_big,
    n_train  = N_proj,
    seed_rf  = seed + 101L,
    dgp_fun  = dgp_fun,
    dgp_args = dgp_args
  )

 

  # Π μ_n : z(W) = μ_n_fun(W)
  Pi_mu_n_big <- rf_project(
    gen_fun  = function(d) mu_n_fun(d$W),
    mu0_eval = mu0_big,
    n_train  = N_proj,
    seed_rf  = seed + 103L,
    dgp_fun  = dgp_fun,
    dgp_args = dgp_args
  )
  Pi_mu_n_big_2 <- rf_project(
    gen_fun  = function(d) mu_n_fun(d$W),
    mu0_eval = mu0_big,
    n_train  = N_proj,
    seed_rf  = seed + 1033L,
    dgp_fun  = dgp_fun,
    dgp_args = dgp_args
  )

  #========================================
  # 5. Compute beta_{n,0} (with & without calibration)
  #========================================
  Delta_centered <- Delta_big - Pi_Delta_big
  norm_Delta <- sqrt(abs(mean(Delta_centered*Delta_centered)))

 

  ## ---- WITH calibration ----
  mu_centered <- mu_n_big - Pi_mu_n_big
  mu_centered_2 <- mu_n_big - Pi_mu_n_big_2

  num      <- mean(Delta_centered * mu_centered)
  den      <- abs(mean(mu_centered*mu_centered_2))
  beta_n0  <- num / den

  DR <- mean((mu_n_big - mu0_big) * Delta_big) /
        mean((mu_n_big - mu0_big)^2)

  norm_mu  <- sqrt(den)
  upper_bd <- norm_Delta * norm_mu
  beta_upper <- upper_bd / den
  
  norm_rel <- den/mean((mu_n_big - mu0_big)^2)

  if (print_diag) {
 
    cat("--- WITH isotonic calibration ---\n")
    cat(sprintf("‣ β_{n,0}                        = %.6f\n", beta_n0))
    cat(sprintf("‣ β_{n,0} (upper bound)          = %.6f\n", beta_upper))
    cat(sprintf("‣ DR remainder                   = %.6f\n", DR))

    cat("----------------------------------------\n")
  }

  list(
    base_mu          = base_mu,
    norm_Delta       = norm_Delta,
    beta_n0          = beta_n0,
    beta_upper       = beta_upper,
    norm_mu          = norm_mu,
    num              = num,
    den              = den,
    DR               = DR,
    norm_rel = norm_rel
  )
}

```




```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Simulation parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------
n        <- 3000
ps       <- 300
sparsity <- c(0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
M        <- 100   # number of Monte Carlo reps
base_mus <- c("linear", "lasso", "ridge", "earth")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create a common seed grid shared across methods
# ------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(1811292283)

seed_grid <- expand.grid(
  sparsity = sparsity,
  rep      = seq_len(M),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    seed = sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, n(), replace = FALSE)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Function to run one replication for given base_mu and sparsity
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_one <- function(base_mu, s, mc_seed) {
  out <- compute_beta_n0(
    base_mu   = base_mu,
    n         = n,
    N_big     = 1e5,
    seed      = mc_seed,
    dgp_fun   = generate_jrssb_dgp,
    dgp_args  = list(
      p           = ps,
      rho         = 0.4,
      n_shared    = floor(ps/3),
      n_A_only    = floor(ps/3),
      n_Y_only    = floor(ps/3),
      beta_A_to_Y = 1.5,
      sparsity    = s
    )
  )

  tibble(
    sparsity = s,
    beta_n0  = out$beta_n0,
    DR       = out$DR
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Main loop over methods (linear, lasso)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
results <- map_dfr(
  base_mus,
  function(bm) {
    pmap_dfr(
      list(
        s       = seed_grid$sparsity,
        mc_rep  = seed_grid$rep,
        mc_seed = seed_grid$seed
      ),
      function(s, mc_rep, mc_seed) {
        out <- run_one(base_mu = bm, s = s, mc_seed = mc_seed)
        out$mc_rep  <- mc_rep
        out$base_mu <- bm
        out
      }
    )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary table: mean & SE for each (method, sparsity)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
summary_results <- results %>%
  group_by(base_mu, sparsity) %>%
  summarise(
    beta_n0_mean = median(abs(beta_n0)),
    beta_n0_se   = sd(beta_n0)/sqrt(n()),
    DR_mean      = median(abs(DR)),
    DR_se        = sd(DR)/sqrt(n()),
    rel_inc = median(abs(beta_n0)/abs(DR)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_results
```

 
 

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Simulation parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ns        <- c(2000, 5000, 10000, 20000)
#ps        <- 200
sparsity  <- 1
M         <- 10   # Monte Carlo repetitions
base_mus  <- c("ridge")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create a common seed grid shared across methods & sample sizes
# ------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(918112923)

seed_grid <- expand.grid(
  n   = ns,
  rep = seq_len(M),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(seed = sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, n(), replace = FALSE))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# One replication for a given (base_mu, n)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_one <- function(base_mu, n, mc_seed) {

  ps <- 5*sqrt(n)
  out <- compute_beta_n0(
    base_mu   = base_mu,
    n         = n,
    N_big     = 100000,
    seed      = mc_seed,
    dgp_fun   = generate_jrssb_dgp,
    dgp_args  = list(
      p           = ps,
      rho         = 0.8,
      n_shared    = floor(ps/2),
      n_A_only    = floor(ps/4),
      n_Y_only    = floor(ps/4),
      beta_A_to_Y = 1.5,
      sparsity    = sparsity
    )
  )

  tibble(
    n       = n,
    beta_n0 = out$beta_n0,
    DR      = out$DR
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Main loop over methods
# ------------------------------------------------------------
results <- map_dfr(
  base_mus,
  function(bm) {
    pmap_dfr(
      list(
        n       = seed_grid$n,
        mc_rep  = seed_grid$rep,
        mc_seed = seed_grid$seed
      ),
      function(n, mc_rep, mc_seed) {
        out <- run_one(base_mu = bm, n = n, mc_seed = mc_seed)
        out$mc_rep  <- mc_rep
        out$base_mu <- bm
        out
      }
    )
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary table: median absolute error + SE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
summary_results <- results %>%
  group_by(base_mu, n) %>%
  summarise(
    beta_n0_med = median(abs(beta_n0)),
    #beta_n0_se  = sd(beta_n0)/sqrt(n()),
    DR_med      = median(abs(DR)),
    #DR_se       = sd(DR)/sqrt(n()),
    rel_inc     = median(abs(beta_n0) / abs(DR)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_results
```
